label: Bible Study
prompt: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away _____ things.
verse: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
note: Tucked into the love chapter — growing up in love means putting childish things away.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the _____ of thine heart.
verse: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
note: Delight comes first, then the desires — and the delight tends to reshape what you desire.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the king said, _____ the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verse: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
note: Solomon's famous ruling: threaten to split the baby, and the real mother reveals herself.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the _____ his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verse: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
note: Jeremiah's proverb on habitual sin: some stains you can't scrub out yourself — hence the new-covenant promise later in his book.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with _____ living.
verse: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
note: The prodigal 'wasted his substance with riotous living' — the KJV's elegant phrase for blowing it all.
